query: My hoodie came 3 days ago, still has tags and I never wore it. Am I within the return window?
correction: Yes. Unworn items with tags can be returned within 7 days of delivery, so your hoodie is still eligible. Start the return from My Orders on urbanethreads.in (Policy UT-RET-001).

query: I wore my trousers once to an event, can I still send them back?
correction: Sorry, returns are accepted only for unworn items with original tags within 7 days of delivery, so worn trousers cannot be returned (Policy UT-RET-001).

query: What's the deadline to swap a blazer for another size?
correction: You can exchange an unworn blazer with tags within 15 days of delivery from My Orders on urbanethreads.in (Policy UT-EXC-002).

query: Can I return a vest from your innerwear range if it is unopened?
correction: Innerwear, socks and Final Sale items cannot be returned or exchanged, even if unopened, for hygiene reasons (Policy UT-NRT-003).

query: I bought a Final Sale belt, can I return it for a refund?
correction: Final Sale items cannot be returned or exchanged. All sales on Final Sale products are final (Policy UT-NRT-003).

query: I paid with UPI and my return was approved. How long until the money is back?
correction: For prepaid orders, including UPI, the refund goes back to the original payment source within 5-7 business days after your return passes quality check (Policy UT-REF-004).

query: My COD return was approved. How do I get my money?
correction: For COD orders we refund by bank transfer (NEFT) to an account you share, or as store credit with a 5% bonus. Choose your option in the return request (Policy UT-REF-004).

query: How much is shipping on a ₹650 order?
correction: Orders of ₹999 or less carry a ₹79 shipping charge; orders above ₹999 ship free. Your ₹650 order will have ₹79 shipping (Policy UT-SHP-005).

query: Is there an extra charge for cash on delivery?
correction: Yes, cash on delivery has a ₹49 COD fee, and COD is not available on orders above ₹15,000 (Policy UT-SHP-005).

query: How long does delivery take to Mumbai?
correction: Metro cities like Mumbai get delivery in 2-4 business days after dispatch (Policy UT-DLV-006).

query: I'm in Indore, how many days will shipping take?
correction: Non-metro locations such as Indore get delivery in 5-7 business days after dispatch (Policy UT-DLV-006).

query: Delivery time for Shillong please?
correction: Deliveries to the North-East, including Shillong, take 7-10 business days after dispatch (Policy UT-DLV-006).

query: My watch stopped working after 4 months without any damage. Is it under warranty?
correction: Yes. Watches carry a 6-month manufacturing warranty, so a fault after 4 months of normal use is covered. Share your order ID and a short video of the issue (Policy UT-WAR-007).

query: I dropped my sunglasses and the lens cracked. Can you fix it under warranty?
correction: Sorry, the 6-month warranty on sunglasses covers manufacturing defects only, not physical or water damage, so a cracked lens from a drop is not covered (Policy UT-WAR-007).

query: I ordered your shirt on Flipkart and want my money back, can you do it?
correction: Orders placed on Flipkart follow Flipkart's return and refund process, and Urbane Threads support cannot issue refunds for them. Please raise the return from your Flipkart account (Policy UT-MKT-008).

query: The parcel had someone else's kurta in it, delivered today. What do I do?
correction: Please report a wrong item within 48 hours of delivery with your unboxing photo or video, and we will arrange a replacement or refund (Policy UT-DMG-009).

query: I found a stain on my dress but it was delivered 5 days ago. Can I still claim damage?
correction: Damage claims must be reported within 48 hours of delivery with an unboxing photo or video, so a claim after 5 days is rejected. If the item is unworn with tags, you can still use the 7-day return (Policy UT-DMG-009).

query: What GST is charged on a jacket that costs ₹2,500?
correction: Apparel priced above ₹1,000 per piece is charged 12% GST, so a ₹2,500 jacket carries 12% GST. The GST invoice is emailed on dispatch (Policy UT-GST-010).

query: What GST applies to a ₹799 t-shirt?
correction: Apparel priced at ₹1,000 or less per piece is charged 5% GST, so your ₹799 t-shirt carries 5% GST (Policy UT-GST-010).

query: When do I receive my tax invoice?
correction: Your GST invoice is emailed when your order is dispatched (Policy UT-GST-010).

query: Can I cancel my order? It hasn't shipped yet.
correction: Yes, cancellation is free before dispatch. Cancel it from My Orders on urbanethreads.in (Policy UT-CAN-011).

query: My lawyer will contact you about my missing refund.
correction: I'm sorry about this. I'm escalating your case to a senior member of our support team, who will contact you within 24 hours (Policy UT-ESC-012).

query: I'm disputing the payment with my credit card company.
correction: I'm escalating your case to a senior member of our support team right away; they will contact you within 24 hours about the payment dispute (Policy UT-ESC-012).

query: Mujhe ₹28,000 ka order return karna hai, kaise hoga?
correction: Orders above ₹25,000 are handled by a senior support specialist. I'm escalating your request and they will contact you within 24 hours (Policy UT-ESC-012).
